574-7084-7893.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a 1/1 green Elf creature token
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-7084-7893.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

864-4826-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
864-4826-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
864-4826-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Eternal Witness and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

2054-2440-4183-7895.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Little Bear
2054-2440-4183-7895.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Little Bear with haste.
When the token Little Bear enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Little Bear trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Little Bear, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Little Bear for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Urn of Godfire twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

Play Dimir Aqueduct.

Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1558-2638-4231-5621-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-4231-5621-7810.description:
Play Arid Archway.

Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Repeat each combat phase.

3213-5016-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
3213-5016-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Spitemare indestructible using Boromir.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.

Spitemare triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.

3213-5016-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

813-3617-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Scholar of the Ages and exiling Ephemerate.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

You control another nonland creature.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Abzan Ascendancy and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

When the creature dies, Sword of the Realms and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.

Kiora's Follower exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.

277-1479-3875-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-3875-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Ornithopter and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Metamorph by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.

Resolve Activated Sleeper's ability, choosing not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers and Blasting Station triggers.
Resolve Activated Sleeper's ability, choosing not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 9, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 7, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 5.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
When the Zombie dies, it triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to its power.

When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, putting at least seven +1/+1 counters on Nadier, and the remaining one +1/+1 counter on any creature(s) you control.
Kill Nadier, triggering its ability, creating at least ten 1/1 Elf Warrior and ten 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Activated Sleeper.

When Priest of Fell Rites enters the battlefield, Righteous Valkyrie's first ability triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Priest of Fell Rites' toughness.
Repeat.

Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.

Resolve all but one Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

413-3413-4875.description:

When the Zombie enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

2104-2493-3557.description:

Move to your combat phase.
Deal combat damage with Brago, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
